title: How AI Is Crushing Junior Developers
summary: Explainer on AI and the collapse of entry-level jobs for 2025 graduates, across tech, law and support.

assertions.quote: businesses are now replacing entry-level jobs with artificial intelligence

verdicts.note: Stanford 'Canaries' (2025) found ~13% relative employment decline for 22-25-year-olds in AI-exposed jobs, but rates, over-hiring correction and other macro factors also matter.

assertions.quote: where three or four junior employees were once needed ... today a smaller team with advanced tools can fulfill the same role

verdicts.note: Hiring data (e.g. Stanford 'canaries' 2025) shows junior roles hit harder than senior, but evidence that senior demand rose is weaker.

assertions.quote: The challenge is not explained solely by the macroeconomic situation

verdicts.note: The 2022-23 decline began before ChatGPT and tracks rate hikes and over-hiring; most economists attribute it mainly to macro factors, though AI may weigh on junior roles since 2024.
